Marketing & reviews - AI tools for contractors

Getting found locally, collecting reviews, and producing content without a marketing team.

Why this matters Most trade businesses get the majority of new work from local search and word of mouth.

What Marketing & reviews actually involves

Most trade businesses live on local search and word of mouth, which means reviews and a complete Google Business Profile usually matter more than a website. The tools here handle review requests, local ranking and the kind of content you do not have time to write yourself.

Frequently asked questions

Which marketing & reviews tools are worth trying first?

The three that stand out here are ServiceTitan (Established businesses with multiple crews and a dedicated office team), Podium (Businesses where most enquiries arrive by text or webchat), Structurely (Contractors with long sales cycles who lose leads to slow follow-up). Start with the one that matches your size and the work you do most, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does marketing & reviews software cost?

Across the 9 tools on this page, 4 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices move often, so confirm on the vendor site before committing.

Can I try these tools for free?

Yes 鈥?Canva Magic Studio, Semrush, ChatGPT, Grammarly all have a free tier, so you can run a few real jobs through them before paying anything.

What actually gets a trade business more reviews?

Asking at the moment the job finishes, with a direct link. Requests sent days later get a fraction of the response rate, and most happy customers simply never think to leave one unprompted.
